idle.action: subtle breathing and one blink; feet planted; front view

walk-down.action: front-view walking toward camera; alternating legs and arms; clear gait cycle

walk-up.action: back-view walking away from camera; alternating legs and arms; clear gait cycle

walk-left.action: side-view walking left; alternating legs and arms; clear gait cycle

walk-right.action: side-view walking right; alternating legs and arms; clear gait cycle

work.action: sitting or standing at desk typing on a laptop; small arm and head motion; no detached UI

talk.action: standing talking gesture; mouth and one hand move slightly; feet planted

style: match the attached base/anchor reference image EXACTLY: same pixel density, same body proportions, same outline weight, same palette, same shading style. Do not restyle.
